Dear Partner:

Here are the leads that are awaiting your action:
(Lead.FirstBucket)(Lead.SecondBucket)(Lead.ThirdBucket) Please click the following link to access these leads now: https://partners.intel.com
For training or support on how to handle these contacts, visit the following link: https://partners.seek.intel.com/SupportPage
Thank you for acting on these past-due contacts. We look forward to sending additional qualified leads your way.
